crop.notes: 'The Ring' column with three items: Lem McGregor's letter to the Police Gazette, the Dacey-Campbell bout, and 'Going to the Fight'. Only the last paragraph mentions Allen; it is complete.

ocr.notes: Minor errors ('Tem McGregor', 'pugeome firmament', 'Lome od', 'Overin St. Lonis').

metadata.notes: Masthead reads THE POST-DISPATCH, ST. LOUIS, THURSDAY EVENING, JANUARY 8, 1891, pages 9 and 10.

facts.fact: Allen was among the St. Louis sporting men, with Tom Kelly, the Daly brothers, the McManus brothers and Bob Farrell, preparing to travel to New Orleans for the Dempsey-Fitzsimmons fight the following Wednesday night

notes: The article only says the fight takes place 'next Wednesday night'; from a Thursday, January 8, 1891 paper that is January 14, 1891.
